results.why: No candidate scores whether the takeaway is a revised belief versus a usable artifact; K30/K31 only contrast benchmark/dataset framing against method framing, which is artifact-vs-artifact, not insight-vs-artifact.

K32 (scale and resource signaling) is broader — it counts models, languages, participants, modalities and infrastructure, not specifically advertised counts of experiments/benchmarks — and K12/K21 score formulaic connectives with 'extensive experiments' as only one incidental cue, so nothing is substitutable for count-advertising.

K45 is the nearest but scores frontier/proprietary compute access (industrial models, FLOP budgets, paid annotation panels), whereas T03 scores evidenced construction effort of any scale, so per-abstract scores would diverge for large hand-built artifacts from small groups.

T04 counts specifically multiplicative speedup notation, while K08, K27 and K36 all score general numeric/decimal result density of which speedup figures are one small sub-case — the candidates are clearly broader.

K18 scores rhetorical appeals to theory/proofs/guarantees anywhere, and K33 scores notation density, neither of which is subfield membership in learning theory/optimization — an applied paper citing a theorem would split them.
No candidate scores passive-voice grammar; K23 counts first-person plural actions, which correlates loosely but scores a different construction and would not substitute.

T07 requires a live public link and explicitly excludes anonymised placeholders and future promises, whereas K19/K43 center on the promise/anonymised convention and K39 is broad release rhetoric — K16 even scores the opposite pole, so none is substitutable.

K50 rates the frequency and intensity of exactly the same promotional vocabulary list (novel, first, significant, comprehensive, superior, state-of-the-art) while forbidding judgment of justification, matching T08's instruction almost word for word.

All four score the presence, prominence, and repetition of coined capitalized method/system/dataset names while explicitly barring judgment of cleverness, which is the same branding property T09 measures.
No candidate scores the scare-quote/coinage-in-quotation-marks habit; K02/K44/K48 cover markup residue and K20/K49 cover typographic name-stylization, both different devices.

K19 scores presence and prominence of exactly the anonymised-repository reference or 'will be released upon acceptance' promise, with the same do-not-judge-the-practice caveat, making it directly substitutable for T11.

No candidate scores the choice of contribution noun (framework/paradigm/pipeline/scheme versus algorithm/model/bound); K30/K31 concern benchmark-versus-method contribution type, not the abstraction level of the noun used.
